en.headline: 395 own commits and 686 automated across 13 repos, with skill tooling releases
en.teaser: Most of the window went into OpenCode skill tooling: skill management, model picking, agent sandboxing and a translation extension, plus issue reports on OpenChamber and OpenCode.
en.overview:
The window ran from 2026-10-06 to 2026-11-04 with data for every day. Across 13 repositories the account recorded 395 own commits plus 686 automated commits, 44 issue actions and no pull requests or reviews.

### Skill and plugin tooling

Most of the work went into OpenCode skill tooling. `opencode-skill-management` built the skill_management plugin with list, inspect, disable and enable actions, moved plans into `.openchamber/plans`, normalized line endings to LF, and shipped 0.1.0-rc.0, 0.1.0-rc.1, 0.2.0, 1.0.0, 1.1.0 and 1.2.0, the last turning all four actions into a single validated JSON result. `opencode-go-model-picker` added shared JSON and proxy helpers, fuller agent discovery with skipped built-ins reported, atomic snapshot writes, version-drift checks and a priced-accounting reference, releasing 1.4.0, 2.0.0, 3.0.0 and 3.0.1. `opencode-agent-sandbox` started from an initial commit and grew a knowledge base covering OpenCode V2 distribution, authentication, Windows path issues and remote branch deletion.

### Translation, pixel art and research

`sopen-translate` was initialized and grew an MV3 extension skeleton, a provider protocol layer with presets and a glossary pipeline, bilingual page rendering with chunk splitting and a circuit breaker, page-state resets between runs, JSDoc type checking and a DOM smoke test; selection translation was later dropped. `pixel-logo-toolkit` added automatic text wrapping with overflow protection, bilingual CLI output, an English-first README with a Chinese version, a 40-image command gallery, a Korean font fix and README corrections, releasing 0.2.0 and 0.3.0. `meld-deepresearch` restructured both READMEs to the Standard Readme spec, added a thin `meld.py` CLI, lightened the skill, made the academic degrade test dependency-aware and released v0.3.1 and v0.4.0.

### Profile, blog and inventory

The profile repository `sogeisetsu` added Discussions collection and display to the daily report, documented the release flow with diagrams of the push pipeline and Workers Builds deployment, recorded watchdog configuration and added a branch-first rule to AGENTS.md. `asset-inventory` corrected skill invocation facts across rules, samples and guides, fixed Japanese localization and released v1.15.4 and v1.15.5. `myBlog` added OpenChamber capture samples for desktop, mobile and panel regions.

### Upstream issue reports

Outside the account's own repositories, 23 issue actions went to openchamber/openchamber, covering storage management, MCP settings, session retention hints, quote-card navigation, file-view commenting, context panel breakdowns, capture resolution and model thinking levels; several were closed by maintainers. 12 issue actions went to anomalyco/opencode, mainly around MiMo vision models on the Go endpoint and Windows CLI access. Two issue actions went to oh-my-opencode-slim and one to SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch.

highlights.text: v1.0.0 froze the skill_management surface for 1.x, with list, inspect, disable and enable writing a single permission rule.
3.0.0 cut the model-facing documentation from about 104,000 to about 8,300 characters.
v0.3.0 added automatic text wrapping and overflow protection with a 9px font floor.
v0.4.0 introduced the meld.py thin CLI wrapping all six gate scripts behind one outdir.
Opened a bug report that Settings > MCP omits the Console MCP server OpenCode adds at runtime; it was later closed.
Opened and later closed a report that mimo-v2.6-flash and mimo-v2.5 advertise image input but the Go endpoint rejects images.
Started an Ideas discussion proposing commenting on selected code rather than only selected line numbers.
Opened a temporary opencode smoke-test issue and closed it after verification.

zh.headline: 13 个仓库共 395 次本人提交与 686 次自动提交，技能工具多次发版
zh.teaser: 本窗口主要投入 OpenCode 技能工具链：技能管理、模型选择、代理沙箱与翻译扩展，并在 OpenChamber 和 OpenCode 上提交了问题报告。
zh.overview:
本窗口为 2026-10-06 至 2026-11-04，30 天均有数据。13 个仓库合计 395 次本人提交，另有 686 次自动提交，44 次 issue 互动（新开、关闭或评论），没有拉取请求和评审。

### 技能与插件工具

大部分工作集中在 OpenCode 技能工具链。`opencode-skill-management` 实现了 skill_management 插件的 list、inspect、disable、enable 四个动作，把计划迁到 `.openchamber/plans`，统一换行符为 LF，并先后发布 0.1.0-rc.0、0.1.0-rc.1、0.2.0、1.0.0、1.1.0 和 1.2.0，最后一版把四个动作统一为单个经校验的 JSON 结果。`opencode-go-model-picker` 增加了共享的 JSON 与代理辅助函数、更完整的 agent 发现（并报告被跳过的内置项）、快照原子写入、版本漂移检查与计价核算参考，发布 1.4.0、2.0.0、3.0.0 和 3.0.1。`opencode-agent-sandbox` 从初始提交起步，逐步积累知识库，涵盖 OpenCode V2 分发、认证、Windows 路径问题和远程分支删除。

### 翻译、像素图与研究

`sopen-translate` 完成初始化，并加入 MV3 扩展骨架、带预设与术语表的提供方协议层、支持分块与熔断的双语页面渲染、两次运行间的页面状态重置、JSDoc 类型检查和 DOM 冒烟测试，随后移除了划词翻译。`pixel-logo-toolkit` 加入自动折行与溢出保护、中英双语命令行、英文优先并附中文版的 README、40 张命令示例画廊、韩文字体修正和 README 修订，发布 0.2.0 和 0.3.0。`meld-deepresearch` 按 Standard Readme 规范重构两份 README，新增轻量 `meld.py` 命令行，精简技能内容，让学术降级测试按依赖情况执行，并发布 v0.3.1 和 v0.4.0。

### 主页、博客与清单

主页仓库 `sogeisetsu` 为日报加入 Discussions 采集与展示，用图记录推送流程与 Workers Builds 部署，补充 watchdog 配置说明，并在 AGENTS.md 中加入「代码修改必须走分支」的约束。`asset-inventory` 修正规则、示例与指南中的技能调用说明，修复日文本地化，发布 v1.15.4 和 v1.15.5。`myBlog` 增加了 OpenChamber 的桌面、移动端与面板区域截图样例。

### 上游问题反馈

在本人仓库之外，openchamber/openchamber 有 23 次 issue 互动，涉及存储管理、MCP 设置、会话保留提示、引用卡片跳转、文件视图评论、上下文面板拆分、截图分辨率与模型思考等级，其中多项已被维护者关闭。anomalyco/opencode 有 12 次 issue 互动，主要围绕 Go 端点的 MiMo 视觉模型和 Windows 命令行入口。oh-my-opencode-slim 有 2 次，SenseNova-Skills-DeepResearch 有 1 次。

highlights.text: v1.0.0 将 skill_management 的接口在 1.x 内冻结，list、inspect、disable、enable 只写入一条权限规则。
3.0.0 把模型需要阅读的文档从约 104,000 字符压缩到约 8,300 字符。
v0.3.0 加入自动折行与溢出保护，字号下限为 9px。
v0.4.0 引入 meld.py 轻量命令行，用一个 outdir 参数封装全部六个闸门脚本。
提交了设置 > MCP 未显示 OpenCode 运行时添加的 Console MCP 服务器的缺陷报告，该问题随后被关闭。
提交并随后关闭了 mimo-v2.6-flash 与 mimo-v2.5 声明支持图片输入但 Go 端点拒绝图片的报告。
发起 Ideas 讨论，建议支持对选中代码而非仅对选中行号发表评论。
新开一个临时的 opencode 冒烟测试 issue，验证完成后关闭。
